entries.title: Psalms 120:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of Ascents.>> In my distress I cried to the LORD, And He heard me.

entries.title: Psalms 120:2
segments: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips [And] from a deceitful tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 120:3
segments: What shall be given to you, Or what shall be done to you, You false tongue?

entries.title: Psalms 120:4
segments: Sharp arrows of the warrior, With coals of the broom tree!

entries.title: Psalms 120:5
segments: ¶Woe is me, that I dwell in Meshech, [That] I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

entries.title: Psalms 120:6
segments: My soul has dwelt too long With one who hates peace.

entries.title: Psalms 120:7
segments: I [am for] peace; But when I speak, they [are] for war.
